about_the_game:
The Cold is Just the Beginning

You are Anna, a young geophysicist, trapped in an unknown underground military complex, under the extreme cold of the Russian climate. Anna desperately tries to survive and find a way out, but something down there disturbingly draws her deeper, and that unknown haunting place bizarrely welcomes her more and more...

About the Demo

This Demo is a vertical slice of the full game, highlighting some of the core features, such as exploration, combat, atmosphere and aesthetics. It consists of a small segment created from an area in the full game, the abandoned military bunker. Narrative and other regions are not a focus on this Demo.

In terms of localization, the Demo has texts in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Full game will have this, plus dubbing in English and Brazilian Portuguese, and texts in Russian, Spanish and French.

Progress made in this demo will not be saved and carried over to the full game.

Kriophobia is a survival horror in third person, inspired by the old-school games of the same genre. Immerse yourself in a Cold and Inhuman World of Mad Obsession, Extremist Patriotism and Disturbing Relationships, presented with a Unique Art-Style that mixes comics and painting.

DEMO FEATURES

  • Cold, Obscure and Terrifying scenarios to be Explored

  • Evasive Combat centered on fleeing and hiding from gruesome abominations

  • Survival with Limited Resources against Freezing Temperatures in a hostile place

  • Dark Visual Style that blends Comics and Painting in a unique way

  • Fully Illustrated Game World displayed with modern Static Cameras

  • An Exclusive Slavic and Russian Inspired soundtrack

content_descriptors.notes:
Fantasy violence, including combat with monsters and monsters attacking the player.
Presence of corpses, blood, and depictions of death.

short_description: You are Anna, a lonesome geophysicist trapped in a military base in the depths of a mysterious Russian island, where the cold is deadly. Hauntings beyond her comprehension inhabits under the snow, and they conceal a disturbing past in which she has to unveil in order to survive.
